about: An Okuma turning program with no machine chosen: the control powers on in G95 and G90 (the profile's documented reset state, assumed), G50 S is the clamp, and a T word inside a G74 cycle block only switches the offset of the tool already in the turret.

states.about: The file header is no block. Nothing is written yet, so everything in force is the power-on state of the profile, and every such value says it is assumed (AD-19 rule 8). The diameter mode is the profile's default for a lathe.
AD-19 rule 4 on this dialect's own clamp code: the S of G50 is the highest spindle speed, not a speed.
A six-digit T word: nose-radius set 01, station 01, offset 01.
The program now states the feed mode itself, so it is no longer assumed.
A four-digit T word: station 02, offset 02.
T0203 in a G74 block switches the offset for the cycle's end point and is not a tool change (the profile's toolCall.ignore). G74 is a cycle of its own block only.
